title: Riglane Spec Registry (_registry.json)
description: Per-scope engine-owned mapping at .riglane/specs/<scope>/_registry.json. Answers 'which file implements/affects which spec'. Populated at IMPLEMENTATION time via the spec_link tool (engine validates the delta) — NOT at extraction (no code yet → implemented_by legitimately empty). Design: sub_tasks/spec-system-revision/design/index-registry.md §2.

version.description: Schema version. Starts at 1 (clean v1). mappings is an OBJECT keyed by spec_id (fixes A3, where ensureScopeDir seeded an array).

scope.description: The scope this registry belongs to. Equals the directory it lives in (fixes A2 — registry is scope-aware).

mappings.description: Map of spec_id -> mapping. OBJECT (not array) so lookups are O(1) and there is exactly one mapping per spec.

spec.description: Spec file path relative to project root, e.g. specs/generic/auth/auth-001.md.

implemented_by.description: Source files related to this spec, each with a role. Empty for specs authored without code (extraction).

implementedBy.description: One file<->spec relationship. role is a verb prescribing a verification action (index-registry §2.2). added_by/added_at are provenance for the remove guard (§2.3).

file.description: Source file path relative to project root.

role.description: implements = produces the behavior (verify ALL requirements) · configures = sets the constrained values, incl. former 'style' (verify the values) · verifies = tests the behavior (verify coverage) · uses = consumes the spec's contract (don't break consumption) · affects = indirect dependency that ripples into the spec (proactively re-verify on change).

note.description: Optional free-text specifics written by the agent at spec_link (e.g. 'sets warning color to red'). Nothing depends on it; valued for audit/provenance.

added_by.description: Provenance: the run_id that added this mapping (used by the remove guard).

added_at.description: Provenance: date this mapping was added (ISO YYYY-MM-DD).
